sentences.text:
Smt. Ram Kanwar W/o Shri Heer Singh, Aged About 50 Years,
Resident Of Jadi Ps Dhanera District Banskantha Gujrat (Lodged In Central Jail, Jodhpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sarvan Sainee For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sameer Pareek, PP  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 08/05/2025 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.

2. The present bail application has been filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (B.N.S.S.), 2023 on behalf of the petitioner, who is in custody in connection with F.I.R.
No.11/2016 dated 04.01.2016, registered at Police Station Kotwali Jalore, District Jalore, for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 408, 409, 120B of IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the co- accused Bhanwar Singh has already been enlarged on bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in CRLMB No.9948/2024 vide order dated 30.08.2024.
He further submits that the case of the petitioner is not distinguishable from the co-accused.
He further submits that the offences are triable by Magistrate.

He further submits that the trial of the case will take long time and no useful [2025:RJ-JD:22246] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-5396/2025] purpose would be served by keeping her behind the bars, therefore, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
Smt. Ram Kanwar vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22246) on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21667198/
1 4.

entities.text: Ram Kanwar vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22246)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application but is unable to refute the fact that similarly situated co-accused has been enlarged on bail and the offences are triable by Magistrate.

5. Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances of the case as available on record and looking to the fact that the the trial will consume time, thus, without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioner deserves to be released on bail.

6. Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (B.N.S.S.), 2023 is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Smt. Ram Kanwar W/o Shri Heer Singh, arrested in relation to F.I.R. No.11/2016 dated 04.01.2016, registered at Police Station Kotwali Jalore, District Jalore, shall be enlarged on bail provided she furnishes a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for her appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(DR. NUPUR BHATI),J 225-amit/-
